trail.name: Colter Bay Lakeshore Trail
trail.coordinateNote: Center of the reconciled USGS geometry extent, used for area weather; not an official trailhead position.

comparison.note: Fifteen NPS-origin USGS Lakeshore Trail segments total 2.331 miles, about 6% above the official NPS round-trip distance. The reconciled segments form a close geometry bridge.
